tinvblocks.headline: Rethinking the information kept in a smaller image
tinvblocks.headlineZh: 重新思考小图像应当保留的信息
tinvblocks.dek: Learned rescaling controls both directions, so the low-resolution image is a designed container. What goes in it is the design decision.
tinvblocks.dekZh: 学习式缩放同时控制两个方向，因此低分辨率图像是一个被设计出来的容器——往里面放什么，就是设计决策本身。

keypoints.en: Learned rescaling controls both sides of the compression: the low-resolution image is a designed representation, not an arbitrary degraded input, so where information is placed is part of the model.
keypoints.zh: 学习式缩放同时控制压缩的两端：低分辨率图像是一个被设计的表示，而非任意的退化输入，因此信息放在哪儿本身就是模型的一部分。

keypoints.en: The low-frequency branch is split into luminance (Y) and chrominance (CbCr) instead of RGB, removing channel redundancy, and reconstruction uses an all-zero high-frequency input so recovery information has to live in the small image.
keypoints.zh: 低频分支被拆分为亮度（Y）与色度（CbCr）而非 RGB，以消除通道冗余；重建时高频输入置零，迫使恢复所需的信息必须留在小图里。

keypoints.en: Plug-and-play: inserted into IRN-style rescaling and SAIN-style compression-aware pipelines, T-SAIN gains 0.4–0.6 dB at 2× and 0.2–0.5 dB at 4× over SAIN on JPEG-compressed DIV2K, at comparable parameter counts.
keypoints.zh: 即插即用：嵌入 IRN 式缩放与 SAIN 式压缩感知流水线后，T-SAIN 在 JPEG 压缩的 DIV2K 上相对 SAIN 提升 0.4–0.6 dB（2×）与 0.2–0.5 dB（4×），参数量相当。

p: Image rescaling is not super-resolution with extra steps. Downscaling and upscaling are designed together, so the low-resolution image is not an arbitrary degraded input but a container the system itself filled — and what it chose to put there determines what can later be recovered.

Invertible networks make this explicit. One network handles both directions: a forward map that must be invertible by construction, plus a learned distribution for whatever is discarded. The usual design splits the representation into a low-frequency branch and a high-frequency branch, models the high-frequency part as noise, and processes the low-frequency part directly in RGB.

T-InvBlocks changes what the surviving branch holds. It separates luminance from chrominance so the invertible map stops spending capacity on the correlation between R, G and B, and it forces the high-frequency input to zero at reconstruction time. Inserted into existing pipelines it gains 0.4–0.6 dB at 2× under JPEG compression at comparable parameter counts.
pz: 图像缩放不是多了几步的超分辨率。下采样与上采样是被联合设计的，因此低分辨率图像不是一个任意的退化输入，而是系统自己填充好的一个容器——它当初选择往里放什么，决定了之后能恢复出什么。
可逆网络把这件事说得明白：一个网络同时处理两个方向，一个构造上可逆的前向映射，加上一个为被丢弃部分学习的分布。常见设计把表示拆成低频与高频两支，把高频当作噪声建模，而低频直接在 RGB 域处理。
T-InvBlocks 改变了留存分支所承载的内容。它把亮度与色度分开，使可逆映射不再把容量浪费在 R、G、B 三通道的相关性上，并在重建时把高频输入强制置零。嵌入既有流水线后，在 JPEG 压缩下、参数量相当的前提下取得 0.4–0.6 dB（2×）的提升。

p: A vanilla invertible block splits its input in two and couples the halves with affine transforms that are invertible by construction. One half becomes the low-frequency representation that survives as the small image; the other is the high-frequency detail that must be stored or sampled at reconstruction time.

The tri-branch version is not a third prediction of the same image. It divides the surviving half into luminance and chrominance and keeps the high-frequency branch as a third path, so each branch has a distinct role in the mapping rather than three copies of one job.

The all-zero high-frequency mapping is the sharpest choice. At upscaling time the detail branch is fed zeros instead of a sampled code, which removes the option of leaning on generated detail and pressures the learned downscaler to keep whatever will actually be needed inside the small image.
pz: 普通的可逆块把输入一分为二，再用构造上可逆的仿射变换耦合两半。一半成为留存下来的低频表示，也就是那张小图；另一半是高频细节，必须在重建时被存储或被采样出来。
三分支版本并不是对同一张图做第三次预测。它把留存的那一半再拆成亮度与色度，并把高频分支保留为第三条通路——于是每条分支在映射中承担不同职责，而不是同一件事的三份副本。
高频置零映射是最锋利的设计选择。上采样时，细节分支被喂入零而不是采样出的编码，这就取消了依赖生成细节这条退路，反过来逼迫学到的下采样器把真正需要的信息留在小图里。

sections.h: Why RGB is the wrong space for the surviving half
sections.hz: 为什么 RGB 不是留存半分支该用的空间
p: The redundancy argument is concrete. In a natural image the three RGB channels are strongly correlated — much of what the R channel says is predictable from G and B — so a block processing them jointly spends capacity transmitting essentially the same luminance structure three times.

Splitting into Y and CbCr concentrates most of the perceptually relevant information in one channel and leaves two low-bandwidth chrominance channels. The invertible coupling then operates on a representation whose channels mean different things instead of on three near-copies.

This is why the gain comes from redesigning what is stored rather than from adding depth. The block reportedly drops into existing architectures at comparable parameter counts, which is the signature of a representation change and not of a capacity increase.
pz: 冗余的论证是具体的。自然图像的三个 RGB 通道高度相关——R 通道所表达的内容很大一部分可由 G 与 B 预测——因此一个联合处理三通道的块，等于把同一套亮度结构重复传输了三次，白白消耗容量。
拆成 Y 与 CbCr 之后，大部分感知相关信息集中到一个通道，另留两个低带宽的色度通道。可逆耦合于是作用于一个各通道含义不同的表示，而不是作用于三份近似拷贝。
正因如此，收益来自重新设计所存内容，而不是来自加深网络。该块据称能以相当的参数量嵌入既有架构，这正是“换了表示”而非“加了容量”的特征。

sections.h: What changes when the branches change
sections.hz: 分支改变后发生了什么
p: The evaluation inserts the block into two different families — IRN-style rescaling and SAIN-style compression-aware pipelines — and tests ordinary reconstruction alongside JPEG-compressed reconstruction across several quality factors and 2×/4× scaling.

Testing across two hosts is the load-bearing part. A gain that appears in only one complete network could come from an interaction with that network; the same block improving two architectures points at the representation rather than at the host.

The JPEG setting is the honest test of the idea. Lossy encoding will discard part of the small image regardless, so the real question is whether information was placed where the codec is likely to keep it. Gains of 0.4–0.6 dB at 2× and 0.2–0.5 dB at 4× suggest it was.
pz: 评测把该块嵌入两个不同的体系——IRN 式缩放与 SAIN 式压缩感知流水线——并在多个质量因子、2×/4× 缩放下，分别测试普通重建与经过 JPEG 压缩后的重建。
在两个宿主上测试是承重设计。只在一个完整网络中出现的增益，可能来自与该网络的某种相互作用；同一个块能同时改善两种架构，则指向表示本身而非宿主。
JPEG 场景才是对这个思路的诚实检验。有损编码无论如何都会丢掉小图的一部分，因此真正的问题是：信息是否被放在了编码器倾向于保留的位置上。2× 下 0.4–0.6 dB、4× 下 0.2–0.5 dB 的提升说明它是。

p: The framing that generalises is allocation. Because encoder and decoder are trained together, the system decides what the small image carries; once that is a design variable, luminance/chrominance separation and zero-detail reconstruction are both ways of spending the budget better.

The scope is narrower than super-resolution. This assumes a coordinated encode/decode pipeline where the downscaler is yours. Recovering an arbitrary image from the web is a different problem with none of this control, and the numbers should not be read as a claim about that setting.

One practical limit is worth naming. Forcing recovery information into the small image means that image carries structure a codec may treat as noise. Robustness under JPEG is evidence it works at the tested quality factors, not a guarantee across every compression pipeline a deployment might use.
pz: 可推广的框架是分配。由于编码器与解码器是联合训练的，系统可以决定小图承载什么；一旦这成为设计变量，亮度／色度分离与零细节重建就都成了把预算花得更好的两种方式。
其适用范围比超分辨率要窄。它假定存在一个协同的编解码流水线，且下采样器是你自己的。从网上恢复一张任意图像是完全不同的问题，没有任何这种控制权，这些数字不应被读作对该场景的论断。
还有一个值得点明的实践限制。把恢复信息压进小图，意味着那张图携带了编码器可能视作噪声的结构。在 JPEG 下的鲁棒性证明它在所测质量因子上有效，却不保证在部署可能用到的任何压缩流水线上都成立。

oapt.headline: Restoring images after a second JPEG compression
oapt.headlineZh: 恢复经过二次 JPEG 压缩的图像
oapt.dek: Two JPEG passes with different block grids put up to four artifact patterns inside one 8×8 block. The offset between the grids is the missing information.
oapt.dekZh: 两次 JPEG 压缩的块网格不对齐，会在同一个 8×8 块内留下最多四种伪影模式。两个网格之间的偏移正是缺失的信息。

keypoints.en: A block of the second JPEG can straddle up to four blocks of the first, so a single 8×8 block may contain as many as four distinct artifact patterns — the degradation is piecewise, not uniform.
keypoints.zh: 第二次 JPEG 的一个块最多可以横跨第一次的四个块，因此单个 8×8 块内可能同时存在四种不同的伪影模式——退化是分片式的，而非均匀的。

keypoints.en: A compression offset predictor estimates the shift between the two grids; those estimates partition the features, and hybrid partition attention blocks combine window self-attention with sparse attention over the grouped features.
keypoints.zh: 压缩偏移预测器估计两个网格之间的位移，据此对特征做分组；混合分区注意力块则把窗口自注意力与针对分组特征的稀疏注意力结合起来。

keypoints.en: The pattern-clustering module is a plugin: it can be inserted into other transformer-based restoration models without added computation, and the gain over the compared state of the art exceeds 0.16 dB.
keypoints.zh: 模式聚类模块是插件式的：可以不增加计算地嵌入其他基于 transformer 的恢复模型，相对所对比的最佳方法提升超过 0.16 dB。

p: A photograph is usually compressed more than once. It is saved by a camera, cropped or edited, then saved again and uploaded, and each JPEG pass lays its own 8×8 block grid over the image. Nothing guarantees those grids line up.

When they do not, the artifact structure stops being uniform. The paper’s analysis counts up to four distinct artifact patterns inside a single 8×8 block, because a block of the second compression can straddle four blocks of the first, each with its own quantization history.

That observation is the whole method. Rather than treat double compression as harder single compression, OAPT estimates the offset between the two grids and groups pixels by the pattern they belong to, gaining more than 0.16 dB over the compared state of the art.
pz: 一张照片通常会被压缩不止一次。相机保存一次，裁剪或编辑后再保存一次，然后上传；每一次 JPEG 都在图像上铺下自己的 8×8 块网格。没有任何机制保证这些网格彼此对齐。
一旦不对齐，伪影结构就不再是均匀的。论文的分析指出，单个 8×8 块内最多可出现四种不同的伪影模式——因为第二次压缩的一个块最多可能横跨第一次压缩的四个块，而每个块各有自己的量化历史。
这一观察就是整个方法。OAPT 不去把二次压缩当作“更难的单次压缩”处理，而是估计两个网格之间的偏移，并按像素所属的模式对它们分组，从而相对所对比的最佳方法提升超过 0.16 dB。

p: JPEG splits an image into 8×8 blocks, applies a discrete cosine transform to each, then quantizes the coefficients. Quantization is what loses information, and it is applied per block, so the artifact pattern a pixel shows is determined by which grid cell it fell into.

Apply the grid twice with a crop or shift in between and the second grid no longer coincides with the first. A block in the second pass can overlap four blocks from the first, each quantized independently, so four different artifact signatures coexist inside one block.

This is why models trained for single compression degrade. Their implicit assumption is that artifact structure is spatially uniform at the block scale, and that is exactly what a second misaligned pass breaks. Restoration requires knowing which pattern each pixel belongs to.
pz: JPEG 把图像切成 8×8 的块，对每块做离散余弦变换，再量化系数。真正丢失信息的是量化，而量化是按块进行的，因此一个像素呈现何种伪影，取决于它落进了哪个网格单元。
在中间发生裁剪或位移之后再次铺网格，第二个网格就不再与第一个重合。第二遍中的某个块可能与第一遍的四个块重叠，而每个块都是独立量化的——于是四种不同的伪影特征在同一个块内共存。
这正是针对单次压缩训练的模型会退化的原因。它们隐含假定伪影结构在块尺度上空间均匀，而这恰恰是第二次未对齐压缩所破坏的东西。要恢复图像，就必须知道每个像素属于哪一种模式。

p: OAPT’s first module predicts the offset between the two compression grids. With the offset known, pixels inside any window can be partitioned by which block of the first compression they came from — that is, by their compression history rather than by their coordinates.

The reconstruction network then uses hybrid partition attention blocks. Window-based self-attention handles ordinary local structure, while a sparse attention branch operates over the clustered pattern features, connecting positions that share an artifact signature however far apart they sit.

The two are genuinely complementary. Window attention is good at neighbourhoods and blind to the fact that two pixels on opposite sides of a block boundary may share a quantization history; sparse pattern attention captures exactly that and is useless for local texture.
pz: OAPT 的第一个模块预测两个压缩网格之间的偏移。偏移已知后，任意窗口内的像素就可以按它们来自第一次压缩的哪个块来划分——也就是按压缩历史划分，而不是按坐标划分。
重建网络随后使用混合分区注意力块：基于窗口的自注意力处理常规局部结构，而一条稀疏注意力分支作用于聚类后的模式特征，把共享同一伪影特征的位置连接起来，无论它们在空间上相隔多远。
两者是真正互补的。窗口注意力擅长邻域，却看不见“块边界两侧的两个像素可能共享同一段量化历史”这件事；稀疏模式注意力恰恰捕捉这一点，但对局部纹理毫无用处。

sections.hz: 感知偏移的分组恢复了什么
p: Training synthesises the degradation rather than collecting it: JPEG, then a pixel shift, then JPEG again, with both quality factors sampled from 5 to 95 and offsets from zero to seven pixels. One model covers the whole range instead of one model per setting.

That choice matters for the claim. Sampling both quality factors broadly forces the offset predictor to work both when the first compression was nearly lossless and when it was severe, which is the range real editing histories actually produce.

The reported gain over the compared state of the art exceeds 0.16 dB on double-JPEG restoration, and the pattern-clustering component transfers: inserted into other transformer restoration models it improves them without extra computation. That transfer is the strongest evidence the clustering captures something real about the degradation rather than fitting this network.
pz: 训练是合成退化而非采集退化：先 JPEG，再做像素位移，然后再 JPEG，两个质量因子均在 5 到 95 之间采样，偏移取 0 到 7 个像素。一个模型覆盖整个范围，而不是每个设置各训练一个。
这个选择关系到论断的强弱。宽范围采样两个质量因子，迫使偏移预测器既要在首次压缩近乎无损时工作，也要在首次压缩很重时工作——而这正是真实编辑历史实际产生的区间。
在二次 JPEG 恢复上，相对所对比最佳方法的提升超过 0.16 dB；而模式聚类组件可以迁移：嵌入其他 transformer 恢复模型后同样带来改善，且不增加计算。这种迁移性是“聚类确实捕捉到了退化本身的某种真实结构，而非拟合了这个网络”的最强证据。

sections.h: Degradation structure belongs in the architecture
sections.hz: 退化结构应当进入架构
p: The generalisable move is to expose the structure of the degradation to the attention mechanism. Pixels that look unrelated spatially can share a compression history, and once grouping reflects that, the model can learn relationships it otherwise could not.

The method is also correctly narrow. It models double JPEG specifically — two compression passes with one shift between them. Predictions are only as good as the offset estimator, and a history involving resizing, another codec or more passes introduces structure the model never saw.

For deployment that is a scoping question rather than a defect. Real pipelines have known, enumerable degradation histories, and the useful contribution is a method that turns one specific history into an architectural prior — at the cost of not generalising beyond it.
pz: 可迁移的动作是：把退化的结构暴露给注意力机制。空间上看起来无关的像素可能共享同一段压缩历史；一旦分组反映了这一点，模型就能学到它本来学不到的关系。
这个方法也恰当地把范围收窄了。它专门建模二次 JPEG——两次压缩、其间一次位移。预测效果取决于偏移估计器的好坏；而涉及缩放、其他编码格式或更多次压缩的历史，会引入模型从未见过的结构。
对部署而言，这是范围界定的问题，而不是缺陷。真实的流水线有着已知且可枚举的退化历史，真正有用的贡献是一种把某一种特定历史转化为架构先验的方法——代价是无法推广到它之外。

cpga.headline: Recovering video detail from the codec’s own clues
cpga.headlineZh: 利用编解码器自身的线索恢复视频
cpga.dek: An encoder already estimated motion and recorded what its prediction missed. CPGA feeds both back into the enhancer.
cpga.dekZh: 编码器已经估计过运动，也记录了预测没覆盖的部分。CPGA 把这两者重新送回增强器。

keypoints.en: A codec already computes motion and separates predicted content from residual detail. CPGA reuses both: motion vectors guide temporal aggregation, residuals guide multi-scale non-local spatial aggregation.
keypoints.zh: 编码器已经算过运动，也把可预测内容与残差细节分开了。CPGA 把两者都拿来复用：运动向量引导时间聚合，残差引导多尺度非局部空间聚合。

keypoints.en: The priors are used inside aggregation rather than appended at the output, so they decide which evidence gets gathered instead of only correcting the result afterwards.
keypoints.zh: 先验被用在聚合内部，而不是拼在输出端——因此它们决定的是收集哪些证据，而不只是事后修正结果。

keypoints.en: VCP: 300 videos with bitstream-derived coding priors. On 18 standard sequences under low-delay B at QP=37, average PSNR gain is 0.03 dB over STDR and 0.08 dB over RFDA.
keypoints.zh: VCP：300 个带有码流衍生编码先验的视频。在低延迟 B 配置、QP=37 下的 18 个标准序列上，平均 PSNR 增益相对 STDR 为 0.03 dB、相对 RFDA 为 0.08 dB。

p: A compressed video carries more than the pixels you decode. To build a bitstream the encoder already estimated how content moves between frames and recorded what its prediction could not explain. Motion vectors and residuals are two byproducts most enhancement methods simply throw away.

They are not redundant with the decoded frames. A motion vector is a compact statement about where information is expected to move; a residual marks where the codec’s prediction failed, which is usually where detail is densest and compression damage is worst.

CPGA treats them as evidence. Motion vectors guide aggregation across frames and residuals guide aggregation within a frame, and the work introduces VCP, a dataset of 300 videos with bitstream-derived coding priors. On 18 standard sequences under low-delay B at QP=37 it gains 0.03 dB over STDR and 0.08 dB over RFDA.
pz: 一段压缩视频所携带的，不止是你解码出来的那些像素。为了生成码流，编码器已经估计过内容在帧间如何运动，并记录下了它的预测未能解释的部分。运动向量与残差这两个副产物，被多数增强方法直接丢弃了。
它们与解码出来的帧并不冗余。运动向量是关于“信息预计会移动到哪里”的紧凑陈述；残差则标记了编码器预测失败的位置，那里通常正是细节最密集、压缩损伤最严重的地方。
CPGA 把它们当证据用：运动向量引导跨帧聚合，残差引导帧内聚合，并提出了 VCP——一个包含 300 个视频、带有码流衍生编码先验的数据集。在低延迟 B 配置、QP=37 下的 18 个标准序列上，它相对 STDR 提升 0.03 dB、相对 RFDA 提升 0.08 dB。

sections.hz: 编码器已经算好了什么
p: Inter-frame prediction is the reason video compression works. For each block the encoder searches a reference frame for a similar block, stores the displacement as a motion vector, and encodes the difference — the residual — which is usually small and therefore cheap.

Two useful facts fall out of that search. The motion vector is an estimate of where the corresponding content sits, computed at encode time with full access to the original frames. The residual is a map of where prediction failed, which correlates strongly with edges, texture and occlusion.

Both are cheaper and cleaner than anything an enhancement network would recompute from decoded pixels. The motion estimate was made before compression damage existed, and the residual is a direct measurement of unpredictability rather than a learned guess at it.
pz: 帧间预测正是视频压缩之所以成立的原因。对每个块，编码器在参考帧中搜索相似的块，把位移存为运动向量，并编码两者之差——残差——它通常很小，因此很便宜。
这次搜索顺带产出两个有用的事实。运动向量是“对应内容在哪里”的估计，而且是在编码时、在能够完整访问原始帧的条件下算出来的；残差则是预测失败的地图，与边缘、纹理和遮挡高度相关。
两者都比增强网络从解码像素中重新算出来的任何东西更便宜、更干净：运动估计是在压缩损伤出现之前做出的，而残差是对不可预测性的直接测量，而不是学出来的猜测。

sections.h: Two aggregations, two kinds of evidence
p: Temporal aggregation needs to know which neighbouring frame content actually aligns with the current one. Using the codec’s motion vectors instead of re-estimating alignment removes a specific failure mode: at low bitrates the network’s own flow estimate is computed from the artifacts it is trying to remove.

Spatial aggregation needs to know where to look for repeated structure. Residuals supply that: high residual energy marks the places where local content is complex and where borrowing similar patches from elsewhere in the frame pays off most.

The design detail that matters is placement. Attaching the priors at the output would make them a correction; putting them inside the aggregation modules lets them decide which evidence is gathered in the first place — a different and stronger use of the same information.
pz: 时间聚合需要知道相邻帧中哪些内容真正与当前帧对齐。直接使用编码器的运动向量，而不是重新估计对齐关系，可以消除一个具体的失效模式：在低码率下，网络自己的光流估计是从它正要去除的那些伪影里算出来的。
空间聚合需要知道去哪里寻找重复结构。残差提供了这个信息：残差能量高的地方，正是局部内容复杂、从帧内其他位置借来相似图像块收益最大的地方。
真正关键的设计细节是放置位置。把先验接在输出端，它们只是修正；放进聚合模块内部，它们就能决定一开始收集哪些证据——这是对同一份信息的另一种、也更强的用法。

p: Evaluation uses standard compressed-video sequences under both low-delay B and random-access configurations at several quantization parameters, reporting average PSNR and SSIM alongside a temporal quality-fluctuation analysis.

The fluctuation measure is the right companion metric. Frame-wise averages hide flicker: a method can raise the mean while making per-frame quality oscillate, and viewers notice oscillation far more than a uniform small loss.

The reported margins — 0.03 dB over STDR and 0.08 dB over RFDA on 18 sequences at QP=37 — are small in absolute terms, which is expected this far along the curve. The ablations separating priors from aggregation modules are what distinguish gains from extra bitstream information from gains a larger pixel-based network could have bought.
pz: 评测使用标准压缩视频序列，覆盖低延迟 B 与随机访问两种配置、多个量化参数，报告平均 PSNR 与 SSIM，并附带时间质量波动分析。
波动指标是恰当的伴随指标。逐帧平均会掩盖闪烁：一个方法完全可能抬高均值，同时让逐帧质量来回震荡，而观众对震荡的感知远强于均匀的小幅损失。
所报的差距——18 个序列、QP=37 下相对 STDR 0.03 dB、相对 RFDA 0.08 dB——在绝对值上很小，而在这条曲线的这个位置本就应当如此。真正有价值的是那些把先验与聚合模块分开的消融：它们区分了“来自额外码流信息的增益”与“换一个更大的纯像素网络也能买到的增益”。

p: The framing worth keeping is that a codec is not a black box that damages video and hands it over. It is a pipeline that already performed motion estimation and a prediction/decision split, and that work is reusable evidence for reconstruction.

The practical constraint is access. Motion vectors and residuals come from the bitstream; a service receiving only decoded RGB frames cannot compute them, and the same architecture should not be assumed to keep its advantage in that setting.

That makes this as much a systems paper as a model paper. The question it raises for anyone building an enhancement pipeline is where to attach the enhancer to the decoder — and the answer determines whether the reported margin is available at all.
pz: 值得保留的框架是：编码器并不是一个把视频弄坏然后丢过来的黑盒。它是一条已经完成了运动估计、已经做出预测／残差划分的流水线，而这些工作是可以被重建复用的证据。
实践上的约束是访问权限。运动向量与残差来自码流；一个只接收解码后 RGB 帧的服务无法计算它们，因此不应假定同样的架构在该场景下仍能保持其优势。
这使它既是一篇模型论文，也是一篇系统论文。它向所有构建增强流水线的人提出的问题的是：把增强器接在解码器的哪个位置——而这个答案，决定了上面报出的那点差距到底还在不在。

xpsr.headline: Using language to guide faithful super-resolution
xpsr.headlineZh: 利用语言引导忠实的超分辨率重建
xpsr.dek: A caption tells the diffusion model what the scene contains. It also carries the degradation that produced it — both have to be handled.
xpsr.dekZh: 描述告诉扩散模型场景里有什么，但它同时携带着产生它的那份退化——两者都必须被处理。

keypoints.en: Semantic conditions come from a multimodal language model reading the degraded input, so the useful part — what the scene contains — arrives mixed with the degradation that produced it.
keypoints.zh: 语义条件来自多模态语言模型对退化输入的读取，因此有用的那部分——场景里有什么——是与产生它的那份退化混在一起到来的。

keypoints.en: Semantic-Fusion Attention controls how language and image features interact, and a Degradation-Free Constraint pushes the representation to keep content without carrying the low-resolution image’s corruption into generation.
keypoints.zh: 语义融合注意力控制语言特征与图像特征如何交互；无退化约束则推动表示保留内容，同时不把低分辨率图像的损坏带入生成过程。

keypoints.en: Relative gains over SeeSR on DIV2K-val: 10.34% MANIQA, 8.57% CLIPIQA, 1.64% MUSIQ, with 64.3% selection in a real-image user study — while diffusion methods still trail GAN-based ones on PSNR and SSIM.
keypoints.zh: DIV2K-val 上相对 SeeSR 的提升：MANIQA 10.34%、CLIPIQA 8.57%、MUSIQ 1.64%，真实图像用户研究中选择率 64.3%——而扩散方法在 PSNR 与 SSIM 上仍落后于 GAN 类方法。

p: Diffusion-based super-resolution leans on a text-to-image prior to fill in what the low-resolution input lost. That prior is powerful and indifferent: given a badly degraded patch it supplies the most likely structure, which may have nothing to do with what was actually there.

Language is the obvious additional condition. A caption can say the image contains a shop sign with specific letterforms, supplying high-level context that no amount of upsampling will recover from the pixels. The difficulty is that the caption must be produced from the degraded image and therefore carries its degradation with it.

XPSR is built around that tension. It uses multimodal language models for semantic conditions, fuses them with image features through Semantic-Fusion Attention, and adds a Degradation-Free Constraint so the fused representation keeps the content without importing the corruption. On DIV2K-val it gains 10.34% in MANIQA over SeeSR.
pz: 基于扩散的超分辨率依赖文生图先验来填补低分辨率输入丢失的内容。这个先验强大而冷漠：给定一块严重退化的区域，它会给出最可能出现的结构，而那可能与真实存在的东西毫无关系。
语言是最直觉的附加条件。一段描述可以说出画面里有一块写着特定字形的店招，从而提供无论怎么上采样都无法从像素中恢复的高层上下文。难点在于：这段描述必须由退化图像生成，因此也就带着那份退化一起来了。
XPSR 正是围绕这个张力构建的：它用多模态语言模型提供语义条件，通过语义融合注意力将其与图像特征融合，并加入无退化约束，使融合后的表示保留内容而不引入损坏。在 DIV2K-val 上，其 MANIQA 相对 SeeSR 提升 10.34%。

sections.h: The condition is also a carrier
sections.hz: 条件同时也是一个携带者
p: A semantic condition is attractive because it operates at a level pixels cannot. At 4× or 8× downscaling with compression on top, the identity of an object can be genuinely ambiguous from the image alone, and a caption can commit to one interpretation.

But the caption is generated from the same degraded input. Compression blocks, noise and blur are all present in the encoder’s input, so whatever semantic embedding comes out has been computed over corrupted evidence — the condition is informative and contaminated at once.

Concatenating it with image features therefore does two things at once: it adds high-level guidance and it opens a second path for the degradation to reach the generative process. Any method using language this way has to separate those effects before it can claim the guidance helped.
pz: 语义条件之所以有吸引力，是因为它工作在像素无法触及的层面。在叠加了压缩的 4× 或 8× 下采样下，仅凭图像本身，一个物体的身份可能真的无法确定，而一段描述则可以选定一种解释。
但这段描述是从同一张退化图像生成的。压缩块效应、噪声与模糊都存在于编码器的输入中，因此无论输出何种语义嵌入，它都是在受损证据上计算出来的——这个条件既提供信息，又被污染。
因此，把它与图像特征简单拼接会同时做两件事：既加入高层引导，又为退化进入生成过程开了第二条通路。任何以这种方式使用语言的方法，都必须先把这两种效应分开，才能声称引导起到了作用。

sections.h: Fusion, and a constraint on what is carried
sections.hz: 融合，以及对所携带内容的约束
p: Semantic-Fusion Attention is the mechanism for combining the two modalities. Rather than treating the caption as a fixed prefix, it lets image and semantic features interact, so the influence of language is modulated by what the image actually supports.

The Degradation-Free Constraint is the counterpart that does the separating. It pushes the fused representation toward preserving useful content while discouraging it from encoding the low-resolution image’s degradation — in effect asking the condition to describe the scene and not the damage.

The pairing is the point. Fusion alone would let a contaminated semantic signal through more effectively; the constraint alone would suppress signal along with corruption. Treating semantic assistance and degradation suppression as complementary requirements is what makes the conditioning usable.
pz: 语义融合注意力是结合两种模态的机制。它不把描述当作固定的前缀，而是让图像特征与语义特征相互交互，于是语言的影响会被图像实际支持的内容所调节。
无退化约束则是负责分离的对应件。它推动融合表示保留有用内容，同时抑制其对低分辨率图像退化的编码——实际上是在要求这个条件描述场景，而不是描述损伤。
关键在于两者成对出现。只有融合，会让被污染的语义信号更有效地通过；只有约束，则会把信号连同损坏一起压掉。把语义辅助与退化抑制当作互补的两项要求，才使这套条件化可用。

sections.hz: 把引导与保真分开测量
p: The evaluation covers synthetic degradations and real photographs, with captions produced from the degraded inputs rather than from clean references — the realistic setting, and the one that makes the constraint necessary rather than optional.

On DIV2K-val the reported relative gains over SeeSR are 10.34% in MANIQA, 8.57% in CLIPIQA and 1.64% in MUSIQ, and a real-image user study gives XPSR 64.3% of selections among six methods. These are perceptual measures, and the paper is careful to note that diffusion methods can still trail GAN-based ones on PSNR and SSIM.

That gap is not a footnote. Pixel-level similarity and perceptual quality genuinely disagree for generative restoration, and the paper treats the disagreement as a finding rather than averaging it away — a model can be preferred by humans and farther from the reference at the same time.
pz: 评测覆盖合成退化与真实照片，描述均从退化输入生成、而非从干净参考生成——这是真实的设定，也正是使该约束成为必需而非可选的设定。
在 DIV2K-val 上，相对 SeeSR 的报告提升为 MANIQA 10.34%、CLIPIQA 8.57%、MUSIQ 1.64%；真实图像用户研究中，XPSR 在六种方法间获得 64.3% 的选择率。这些都是感知指标，而论文也谨慎指出：扩散方法在 PSNR 与 SSIM 上仍可能落后于 GAN 类方法。
这个差距不是脚注。对生成式恢复而言，像素级相似度与感知质量确实会给出相反的判断，而论文把这种不一致当作一条发现，而不是把它平均掉——一个模型完全可能同时被人更偏好、又离参考更远。

sections.hz: 要语义辅助，不要语义编造
p: The conditional reading is the honest one. Better conditioning improves this pipeline under these settings; it does not establish that language can recover information absent from an image with certainty, because the caption is itself an inference from degraded evidence.

The failure mode to watch is confident misdescription. If the language model commits to the wrong object, the generative prior will render it convincingly — stronger semantic guidance raises both the quality of correct guesses and the plausibility of wrong ones.

That suggests an asymmetric deployment pattern. Use semantic conditioning where the scene is ambiguous and the interpretation is cheap to verify, and stay sceptical where a wrong guess downstream is expensive. The constraint reduces leakage; it cannot audit the caption.
pz: 诚实的读法是带条件的：更好的条件化在这些设置下改善了这条流水线，但它并未确立“语言能够确定地恢复图像中缺失的信息”——因为描述本身也是从退化证据中推断出来的。
需要警惕的失效模式是自信的错误描述。如果语言模型认错了物体，生成先验会把这个错误渲染得非常可信——更强的语义引导会同时提高正确猜测的质量与错误猜测的可信度。
这提示了一种非对称的部署方式：在场景确实模糊、且解释便于验证的地方使用语义条件化；在下游猜错代价高昂的地方保持怀疑。约束能减少泄漏，但它无法审查那段描述。
